data.name: BestVersionSelectorNode_Name
data.value: Best Version Selector

data.name: BestVersionSelectorNode_Desc
data.value: Compares candidate files (e.g. optimized vs original) using criteria such as smallest size or savings threshold, sets the winner as active, and can auto-purge intermediate losers.

data.name: VersionRouterNode_Name
data.value: Version Router

data.name: VersionRouterNode_Desc
data.value: Evaluates a condition between versions or variables (e.g. optimized size < original size) and routes flow through True or False ports, activating the selected file and purging the unselected intermediate file.

data.name: SwitchActiveFileNode_Name
data.value: Switch Active File

data.name: SwitchActiveFileNode_Desc
data.value: Switches the active file in context (CurrentPath) to the original file or a registered version tag, with an option to purge the previous intermediate file.

data.name: FileForkNode_Name
data.value: File Version Fork

data.name: FileForkNode_Desc
data.value: Clones the item into parallel independent branches: one for original file, one for current version, and one for intermediate registered versions.

data.name: IntermediateCleanupNode_Name
data.value: Intermediate Files Cleanup

data.name: IntermediateCleanupNode_Desc
data.value: Deletes temporary and intermediate files generated by upstream processors from disk, preserving the immutable original file and optionally the active file.

data.name: ExpressionFilterNode_Name
data.value: Logical Expression Filter

data.name: ExpressionFilterNode_Desc
data.value: Evaluates conditions on file properties and routes flow to True or False ports.

data.name: SwitchCaseNode_Name
data.value: Switch / Multi-Branch Router

data.name: SwitchCaseNode_Desc
data.value: Routes flow to matching case branches based on an evaluated expression.

data.name: BatchBufferNode_Name
data.value: Batch Buffer

data.name: BatchBufferNode_Desc
data.value: Buffers incoming items into batches before emitting.

data.name: ThrottleDelayNode_Name
data.value: Throttle Delay

data.name: ThrottleDelayNode_Desc
data.value: Introduces a delay between processed items.

data.name: ForkJoinBarrierNode_Name
data.value: Fork / Join Barrier

data.name: ForkJoinBarrierNode_Desc
data.value: Synchronizes and joins divergent parallel branches.
